note: Byline roster. index.mjs refuses any post whose byline is not listed here, matched exactly, capitalisation included. A column has exactly one owner: the entry that lists it, and no other. The first eight entries are the placeholder newsroom and are retained so the published archive stays valid; the five that follow are the real newsroom, per the BEL-116 ruling. A reporter who needs a column owns one of his own rather than sharing another byline's. Margaret Vance (Chief Executive Officer) and Mara Vance (Managing Editor) are two different people. The slug is margaret-vance and must stay that way. The News Desk belongs to Rosa Delgado by the BEL-192 ruling: it moved off Rosalind Kimbrough, a placeholder byline, because a retired byline can file the archive only, and a column whose only owner is retired cannot be filed at all.
